pick.headline: Israel invades southern Lebanon
pick.summary: On the night of March 14-15, 1978, Israeli forces invaded southern Lebanon in Operation Litani, days after a Fatah raid on the coastal road killed over thirty Israelis.
pick.significance: The invasion led to the creation of the UN force UNIFIL. It was the prelude to the larger invasion of 1982.
pick.fbis: The Middle East and North Africa Daily Report of March 15, 1978, listed under Lebanon a run of Voice of Lebanon reports on the Israeli attack on southern Lebanon, Prime Minister al-Huss's condemnation, and cabinet and aid measures.
